info.title: Global Plastic Trading Intelligence API
info.description: B2B intelligence for LDPE / LLDPE / HDPE (virgin, near-prime, off-grade, recycled). All records are traceable to their source; nothing is fabricated.

post.description: Public endpoint (no auth) so data subjects can request opt-out, correction or deletion.
Upload a permitted CSV/XLSX export. kind = companies | shipments. origin_source = source key the export came from.

get.description: Random auto-classified material rows for manual accuracy review.

delete.description: Deletes personal data. With suppress=true the email/phone is hashed onto the suppression list so it is never re-collected.

get.description: Supplier -> buyer relationships aggregated from shipment records.
